items.t: Automatic transmission shifts erratically with O/D OFF light flashing
items.job: Diagnose transmission; repair harness or replace with used/rebuilt transmission
items.note: Low end is a wiring or sensor repair; high end is a replacement transmission.

items.t: Ignition switch can overheat (recall)
items.job: Replace ignition switch

items.t: Alternator or voltage regulator failure
items.job: Replace alternator
items.note: Add a battery if it was damaged by overcharging.

items.t: Front brake calipers stick
items.job: Replace front calipers and pads

items.t: Broken engine mounts
items.job: Replace engine mount

items.t: Clunk over bumps from worn struts or stabilizer links
items.job: Replace stabilizer links and bushings, or struts
items.note: Links are cheap; a pair of struts is the high end.

items.t: Wheel bearing hum
items.job: Replace front wheel bearing

items.t: Hesitation and jerking when accelerating
items.job: Diagnose drivability; replace intake hose or sensor

items.t: Misfire from a failed ignition coil
items.job: Replace ignition coil

items.t: Check engine light from an EGR fault (P0402)
items.job: Clean or replace EGR valve

items.t: High idle with check engine light (P0507)
items.job: Clean throttle body and idle air control valve

items.t: Hard starting
items.job: Diagnose no-start/hard start and repair

items.t: Rattle from the engine when cold
items.job: Diagnose rattle and secure or replace heat shield

items.t: Rear brake hose damaged at the factory (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace left rear brake hose

items.t: Water can short the radio and overheat a speaker (recall)
items.job: Apply water shield tape over audio unit

items.t: Radiator or water pump leak
items.job: Replace radiator or water pump and refill coolant
items.note: On many Proteges the water pump is changed with the timing belt.

items.t: Oil leak from the valve cover gasket
items.job: Replace valve cover gasket and plug tube seals

items.t: Blower fan works only on high
items.job: Replace blower motor resistor

items.t: Body rust
items.job: Repair rust on rear wheel arches
items.note: Cost depends heavily on how far the rust has spread.

items.t: Power door locks or door key cylinder fail
items.job: Replace door lock actuator or lock cylinder

items.t: Rotten egg smell from the exhaust
items.job: Diagnose fuel mixture; replace catalytic converter if failed

items.t: Musty smell from the A/C vents
items.job: Clean A/C evaporator

items.t: Clunk or thump from the rear suspension
items.job: Replace rear strut mounts or bushings

items.t: Popping from the front brakes at low speed
items.job: Service front caliper slides and pad hardware

items.t: Brake warning light stays on
items.job: Diagnose brake warning light; top up fluid or replace switch

items.t: Weak heat or slow engine warm-up
items.job: Replace thermostat

items.t: A/C stops working with check engine light on
items.job: Diagnose A/C and replace pressure switch

items.t: Noise from the drive shafts
items.job: Replace front CV axle

items.t: Poor engine performance
items.job: Diagnose and tune up (plugs, wires, filters)

items.t: Check engine light from the EGR sensor circuit (P0400)
items.job: Diagnose and repair EGR sensor wiring
